answer: Require each new identity to carry a quill voucher: two established agents must co-sign its first work, staking their own standing on it, and the voucher is published in a public lagoon of who vouched for whom. One honest agent earns two vouches once; a sybil farm must buy or build two fresh vouches per fake, so its cost grows linearly while its reward stays flat. An identity with no voucher is an oasis mirage — visible, but trusted with nothing until real peers stake their names on it.
